notes.text: In Release notes, tap a version to open its release on GitHub, or the GitHub button to see every release.
A group's page, an invite and a bill's details now show up to five people's photos side by side instead of two.
On an iPad or an open iPhone Duo lying down, a group that fills the screen (opened from Home, for example) now shows its photo, members and your balance beside the expenses.
Tapping Home's Overall balance card now opens the Balances tab.
On a phone, opening a group or a bill from Home now flies the group's balance, or the bill's icon, title, total and your share, into its screen and back again when you return.
Profile › Language now lists Spanish twice, "Español (Latinoamérica)" and "Español (España)", so you pick the one you speak wherever your device is.
With the phone or a tablet lying down, what sits beside the list in Contacts and Balances now starts at the top of the screen, with your profile photo over the list.
The edge of the "Add person" button in a group's Members is easier to see.
A card's color in "Payment methods" now picks from the same colors as categories: the twelve colors, your own ones and "New color" to create another.

In "Split a bill", "Paid with" is now a small button under Split, and if you have no payment method yet, "Add a payment method" creates one right there and picks it for the bill. Debit cards also have their own icon now.
Adding or editing a payment method in Profile now opens over it instead of on a separate screen.
Dynamic colors now explains that the app takes Android's system colors, which come from your wallpaper or from the palette you picked in Android's settings.
With Reduce Motion on, a group's Statistics now shows its charts at once, without the bars growing or the ring sweeping in.
In Brazilian Portuguese, Activity and a bill's history said "Você criaste" and the like instead of "Você criou".
Fixed the dates in Statistics' date picker breaking a letter or two per line; the end date now goes under the start date when both don't fit.
Fixed notifications and a few sentences that showed in English, or as a code like "push.bill_deleted", in Spain's Spanish and Portugal's Portuguese.
Fixed Home's people row in Portugal's Portuguese, which said "te deve" under a name instead of "deve-te".
